Use a style definition to set the text color, for example `console.print("Hello", style="#ff8800")`. The [styles documentation](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/docs/source/style.rst) covers named colors, hex colors, and RGB. For questions about your use case, please ask in [Discussions](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/discussions).
